task_text: I need to shower in 5 minutes. Get the bathroom ready and make sure I have what I need.

plans.R1:
[R1 - bedroom]
1. PickupLightObject (towel from the desk)
2. PassReceiveObject (towel to another robot if they come to the bedroom)
plans.R2:
[R2 - bedroom]
1. Turn off the bedroom light to save energy before leaving for the shower.
plans.R3:
[R3 - bathroom]
1. Turn on the shower.
2. Ensure the towel is within reach.
plans.R4:
[R4 - bathroom]
1. Pull shower curtain open
2. Place bath mat in front of the tub
